source_text: Luctatur vir cum eo usque mane. Tetigit nervum femoris — claudicatio sancta. Nomen Israel: videns Deum.
pass_a_gloss: Wrestles man with him until morning. Touched sinew of-thigh — limp holy. Name Israel: seeing God.
pass_b_english: [[A man wrestles with him until morning >> Bible:Genesis 32:24]]. [[He touches the thigh sinew >> Bible:Genesis 32:25]] — a holy limp. The name [[Israel: seeing God >> Bible:Genesis 32:28]].
